```{r}
# 加载必要的库
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)

# 读取数据集
df <- read.csv("credit_risk_dataset.csv")

# 数据清理：基础过滤
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(person_income >= 0, person_age >= 18, loan_amnt >= 0)

# ========== 1. 填补所有数值型缺失值（遍历每一列） ==========
for (col in names(df_clean)) {
  if (is.numeric(df_clean[[col]])) {
    if (any(is.na(df_clean[[col]]))) {
      df_clean[[col]][is.na(df_clean[[col]])] <- mean(df_clean[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      cat(col, "缺失值已用均值填补\n")
    }
  }
}

# ========== 2. IQR剔除异常值（只对分布正常的变量） ==========
remove_outliers_iqr <- function(df, cols) {
  for (col in cols) {
    Q1 <- quantile(df[[col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    Q3 <- quantile(df[[col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    IQR <- Q3 - Q1
    lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
    upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
    
    before <- nrow(df)
    df <- df[df[[col]] >= lower_bound & df[[col]] <= upper_bound, ]
    after <- nrow(df)
    cat(col, "删除了", before - after, "个异常值\n")
  }
  return(df)
}

# 只对分布相对正常的变量用IQR
numeric_cols_iqr <- c("person_age", "person_emp_length", "loan_int_rate")

df_clean <- remove_outliers_iqr(df_clean, numeric_cols_iqr)

# ========== 3. 填补所有类别型缺失值（遍历每一列） ==========
fill_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  mode_val <- names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  x[is.na(x)] <- mode_val
  return(x)
}

for (col in names(df_clean)) {
  if (is.character(df_clean[[col]]) || is.factor(df_clean[[col]])) {
    if (any(is.na(df_clean[[col]]))) {
      df_clean[[col]] <- fill_mode(df_clean[[col]])
      cat(col, "缺失值已用众数填补\n")
    }
  }
}

# ========== 4. 转换为因子并独热编码 ==========
# 转换为因子
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(person_home_ownership, loan_intent, cb_person_default_on_file), as.factor))

# 检查每个待编码因子的水平数
factor_cols <- c("person_home_ownership", "loan_intent", "cb_person_default_on_file")
for (col in factor_cols) {
  cat(col, "有", nlevels(df_clean[[col]]), "个水平\n")
}

# 只保留水平数 >= 2 的因子进行独热编码
cols_to_encode <- factor_cols[sapply(df_clean[factor_cols], nlevels) >= 2]

# 生成独热编码矩阵（仅对有效列）
if (length(cols_to_encode) > 0) {
  formula_str <- paste(paste(cols_to_encode, collapse = " + "))
  formula_obj <- as.formula(paste("~", formula_str, "- 1"))
  dummy_matrix <- model.matrix(formula_obj, data = df_clean)
  
  # 合并编码后的数据
  df_encoded <- cbind(df_clean %>% select(-all_of(cols_to_encode)), dummy_matrix)
} else {
  df_encoded <- df_clean
  warning("没有至少两个水平的因子列，跳过独热编码")
}

# 检查处理后的数据
head(df_encoded)

# 记录最终行数
cat("\n最终数据行数:", nrow(df_encoded), "\n")

# 导出清洗编码后的数据
write.csv(df_encoded, "df_encoded_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("数据已导出: df_encoded_cleaned.csv\n")
```

```{r}
library(ROSE)

# 先执行 ROSE 过采样
set.seed(123)
train_balanced <- ROSE(y_train ~ ., data = cbind(y_train, X_train), p = 0.5, seed = 123)$data

# 提取平衡后的数据

# 对比数据

after_table <- table(y_train_bal)

# 并排柱状图

barplot(before_table, 
        names.arg = c("normal(0)", "default (1)"),
        col = c("steelblue", "coral"),
        main = "Before",
        ylab = "frequency",
        ylim = c(0, max(before_table) * 1.1))
text(x = c(0.7, 1.9), y = before_table + 200, 
     labels = paste0(before_table, "\n(", round(prop.table(before_table)*100, 1), "%)"))

barplot(after_table, 
        names.arg = c("normal (0)", "defualt (1)"),
        col = c("steelblue", "coral"),
        main = "after",
        ylab = "frequency",
        ylim = c(0, max(after_table) * 1.1))
text(x = c(0.7, 1.9), y = after_table + 200, 
     labels = paste0(after_table, "\n(", round(prop.table(after_table)*100, 1), "%)"))
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(ROSE)

# 基于LASSO筛选后的变量准备数据
selected_vars <- c("person_age", "person_income", "person_emp_length", 
                   "loan_amnt", "loan_int_rate", "loan_percent_income","cb_person_cred_hist_length",
                   "person_home_ownershipOTHER", "person_home_ownershipOWN", 
                   "person_home_ownershipRENT", "loan_intentEDUCATION",
                   "loan_intentHOMEIMPROVEMENT", "loan_intentMEDICAL", 
                   "loan_intentPERSONAL", "loan_intentVENTURE",
                   "cb_person_default_on_fileY")

X_selected <- df_encoded[, selected_vars]
y <- df_encoded$loan_status

# 检查并处理缺失值
X_selected[is.na(X_selected)] <- 0

# 划分训练集和测试集
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
X_train <- X_selected[trainIndex, ]
y_train <- y[trainIndex]
X_test <- X_selected[-trainIndex, ]
y_test <- y[-trainIndex]

# 再次检查测试集缺失值
X_test[is.na(X_test)] <- 0

# 处理类别不平衡 - 过采样
set.seed(123)
train_balanced <- ROSE(y_train ~ ., data = cbind(y_train, X_train), p = 0.5, seed = 123)$data
y_train_bal <- train_balanced$y_train
X_train_bal <- train_balanced[, -1]

# Random Forest
rf_model <- randomForest(x = X_train_bal, y = as.factor(y_train_bal), ntree = 100, importance = TRUE)
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, X_test, type = "prob")[, 2]
rf_class <- ifelse(rf_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)

# XGBoost
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_train_bal), label = y_train_bal)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_test), label = y_test)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(data = dtrain, nrounds = 100, objective = "binary:logistic", 
                       eval_metric = "auc", verbose = 0)
xgb_pred <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
xgb_class <- ifelse(xgb_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)

# 评估函数
evaluate <- function(pred_class, pred_prob, y_true, model_name) {
  cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(pred_class), factor(y_true))
  roc_obj <- roc(y_true, pred_prob)
  
  cat("\n========== ", model_name, " ==========\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", round(cm$overall["Accuracy"], 4), "\n")
  cat("Precision:", round(cm$byClass["Precision"], 4), "\n")
  cat("Recall:", round(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4), "\n")
  cat("F1:", round(cm$byClass["F1"], 4), "\n")
  cat("AUC:", round(auc(roc_obj), 4), "\n")
  print(cm$table)
  
  return(list(cm = cm, auc = auc(roc_obj), roc = roc_obj))
}

# 评估两个模型
rf_results <- evaluate(rf_class, rf_pred, y_test, "Random Forest")
xgb_results <- evaluate(xgb_class, xgb_pred, y_test, "XGBoost")

# ROC曲线对比
plot(rf_results$roc, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curves Comparison")
lines(xgb_results$roc, col = "red")
legend("bottomright", legend = c(paste("RF AUC =", round(rf_results$auc, 4)),
                                  paste("XGB AUC =", round(xgb_results$auc, 4))),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1)

# Random Forest特征重要性
importance_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
importance_df$Feature <- rownames(importance_df)
importance_df <- importance_df[order(-importance_df$MeanDecreaseGini), ]
print(importance_df)

# 保存特征重要性
write.csv(importance_df, "feature_importance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cat("High-risk threshold:", threshold, "\n")
```

```{r}
# 选择用于PCA的特征（使用LASSO筛选出的15个变量）
high_risk_features <- high_risk[, selected_vars]

# 检查并处理缺失值

high_risk_scaled <- scale(high_risk_features)
```

```{r}
# 执行PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(high_risk_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# 查看方差解释比例
var_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ]  # 方差比例
cum_var_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[3, ]  # 累计方差比例

# 显示前10个主成分的方差解释率
cat("主成分方差解释率:\n")
for(i in 1:10) {
  cat("PC", i, ": ", round(var_explained[i] * 100, 2), "% (累计: ", round(cum_var_explained[i] * 100, 2), "%)\n")
}

# 确定保留的主成分数量（累计方差 >= 80%）
n_pc <- which(cum_var_explained >= 0.8)[1]
cat("\n保留", n_pc, "个主成分，累计解释", round(cum_var_explained[n_pc] * 100, 2), "%的方差")

# 提取降维后的数据
pca_data <- pca_result$x[, 1:n_pc]
cat("\n降维后数据维度:", dim(pca_data))
```

```{r}
# 计算不同K值的轮廓系数，找出最佳聚类数
library(cluster)

# 测试K=2到10
sil_scores <- c()
for(k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km_result <- kmeans(pca_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  sil <- silhouette(km_result$cluster, dist(pca_data))
  sil_scores[k-1] <- mean(sil[, 3])
  cat("K =", k, "轮廓系数 =", round(sil_scores[k-1], 4), "\n")
}

# 最佳K值
best_k <- which.max(sil_scores) + 1
cat("\n最佳K值:", best_k)

library(ggplot2)

# 构建数据框（K=2 到 10）
df_sil <- data.frame(
  K = 2:10,
  Silhouette = sil_scores
)

# 绘图
ggplot(df_sil, aes(x = K, y = Silhouette)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C3E50", linewidth = 1.2) +          # 深灰线
  geom_point(color = "#E74C3C", size = 3.5, shape = 19) +  # 红色实心点
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Silhouette)), 
            vjust = -1.2, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#2C3E50") +  # 数值标签
  labs(
    title = "轮廓系数随聚类数 K 的变化",
    x = "Cluster(K)",
    y = "Contour coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray92") 
  
  ) +
  ylim(0, 0.3)
```

```{r}
# 1. 先补回缺失的列
high_risk$person_emp_length <- df_encoded[rownames(high_risk), "person_emp_length"]
high_risk$loan_int_rate <- df_encoded[rownames(high_risk), "loan_int_rate"]

# 2. 然后做聚类（这会创建 cluster_cont 列）
cont_features <- high_risk[, c("person_age", "person_income", "person_emp_length", 
                                 "loan_amnt", "loan_int_rate", "loan_percent_income")]

cont_scaled <- scale(cont_features)
cont_scaled[is.na(cont_scaled)] <- 0

set.seed(123)
km_final <- kmeans(cont_scaled, centers = 5, nstart = 25)
high_risk$cluster_cont <- km_final$cluster   # 这里创建 cluster_cont

# 3. 最后才能 group_by(cluster_cont)
cluster_profile_cont <- high_risk %>%
  group_by(cluster_cont) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    违约率 = mean(loan_status),
    年龄 = mean(person_age),
    收入 = mean(person_income),
    工作年限 = mean(person_emp_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    贷款金额 = mean(loan_amnt),
    利率 = mean(loan_int_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    收入负债比 = mean(loan_percent_income)
  )

print(cluster_profile_cont)
```

```{r}
# === 假设您已有以下对象（来自您之前的代码）===
# high_risk_features: 15个特征的原始数据框（已处理缺失值）
# high_risk_scaled: 标准化后的数据（用于PCA）
# pca_result: prcomp() 的结果对象

# 1. 提取载荷矩阵（loadings）——注意：prcomp 的 loadings 是旋转后的特征向量
# prcomp 默认返回的是 rotation 矩阵（即载荷），维度为 p × k（15 × 10）
loadings <- pca_result$rotation[, 1:10]  # 取前10个主成分

# 2. 确保行名是变量名（若没有，手动赋值）
if (is.null(rownames(loadings))) {
  rownames(loadings) <- names(high_risk_features)
}
colnames(loadings) <- paste0("PC", 1:10)

# 3. 绘制热力图（使用 ggplot2 + reshape2 或 tidyr）
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)  # 或用 tidyr::pivot_longer

# 将矩阵转为长格式
loadings_long <- melt(loadings, 
                      varnames = c("Original_Feature", "Principal_Component"),
                      value.name = "Loading")

# 4. 绘图
p <- ggplot(loadings_long, aes(x = Principal_Component, y = Original_Feature, fill = Loading)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4477AA",      # 蓝色（负）
    mid = "white",        # 中性
    high = "#CC3311",     # 红色（正）
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "载荷权重"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA 载荷矩阵热图 (15个原始特征 → 10个主成分)",
    subtitle = "反映了各原始指标在降维后的权重分布",
    x = "主成分 (PCs)",
    y = "原始特征变量"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# 显示图形
print(p)
```

```{r}
# 备选方案：所有cluster在一个图上并排显示
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 准备数据
plot_data_wide <- high_risk %>%
  select(cluster_cont, person_age, person_income, person_emp_length, 
         loan_amnt, loan_int_rate, loan_percent_income) %>%
  group_by(cluster_cont) %>%
  summarise(
    Age = mean(person_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Income = mean(person_income, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Employment Length` = mean(person_emp_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Loan Amount` = mean(loan_amnt, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Interest Rate` = mean(loan_int_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Debt-to-Income Ratio` = mean(loan_percent_income, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster_cont, names_to = "feature", values_to = "mean_value") %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(
    scaled_value = (mean_value - mean(mean_value)) / sd(mean_value),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = c("Debt-to-Income Ratio", "Interest Rate", 
                                          "Loan Amount", "Employment Length", 
                                          "Income", "Age"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 画分组条形图
p_grouped <- ggplot(plot_data_wide, aes(x = scaled_value, y = feature, fill = factor(cluster_cont))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e"),
    name = "Cluster"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Key Feature Contribution per High-Risk Cluster",
    subtitle = "Standardized scores > 0 indicate the feature is above the group average",
    x = "Standardized Score",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

print(p_grouped)
ggsave("cluster_bar_chart_grouped.png", p_grouped, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# 假设 cluster_profile_cont 已经存在，先查看一下数据
print(cluster_profile_cont)

# 计算总体均值和标准差用于标准化
总体均值 <- cluster_profile_cont %>%
  summarise(
    年龄_mean = mean(年龄),
    收入_mean = mean(收入),
    工作年限_mean = mean(工作年限, na.rm = TRUE),
    贷款金额_mean = mean(贷款金额),
    利率_mean = mean(利率, na.rm = TRUE),
    收入负债比_mean = mean(收入负债比)
  )

总体标准差 <- cluster_profile_cont %>%
  summarise(
    年龄_sd = sd(年龄),
    收入_sd = sd(收入),
    工作年限_sd = sd(工作年限, na.rm = TRUE),
    贷款金额_sd = sd(贷款金额),
    利率_sd = sd(利率, na.rm = TRUE),
    收入负债比_sd = sd(收入负债比)
  )

# 计算标准化分数
plot_data <- cluster_profile_cont %>%
  mutate(
    年龄_std = (年龄 - 总体均值$年龄_mean) / 总体标准差$年龄_sd,
    收入_std = (收入 - 总体均值$收入_mean) / 总体标准差$收入_sd,
    工作年限_std = (工作年限 - 总体均值$工作年限_mean) / 总体标准差$工作年限_sd,
    贷款金额_std = (贷款金额 - 总体均值$贷款金额_mean) / 总体标准差$贷款金额_sd,
    利率_std = (利率 - 总体均值$利率_mean) / 总体标准差$利率_sd,
    收入负债比_std = (收入负债比 - 总体均值$收入负债比_mean) / 总体标准差$收入负债比_sd
  ) %>%
  select(cluster_cont, 年龄_std, 收入_std, 工作年限_std, 贷款金额_std, 利率_std, 收入负债比_std) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster_cont, names_to = "feature", values_to = "std_score") %>%
  mutate(
    feature_clean = case_when(
      feature == "年龄_std" ~ "Age",
      feature == "收入_std" ~ "Income",
      feature == "工作年限_std" ~ "Employment Length",
      feature == "贷款金额_std" ~ "Loan Amount",
      feature == "利率_std" ~ "Interest Rate",
      feature == "收入负债比_std" ~ "Debt-to-Income Ratio"
    ),
    # 设置特征的顺序（从上到下）
    feature_clean = factor(feature_clean, levels = c("Debt-to-Income Ratio", "Interest Rate", 
                                                      "Loan Amount", "Employment Length", 
                                                      "Income", "Age")),
    cluster_label = paste("Cluster", cluster_cont)
  )

# 方法1：分面图（最简单，不会报错）
p_facet <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = std_score, y = feature_clean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           aes(fill = std_score > 0),
           width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4575b4", "FALSE" = "#d73027"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster_label, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Key Feature Contribution per High-Risk Cluster",
    subtitle = "Standardized scores > 0 indicate the feature is above the group average.",
    x = "Standardized Score",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_facet)
ggsave("cluster_comparison_facet.png", p_facet, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# 方法2：如果你还是想要单独的5个图（不用plot_spacer）
# 创建5个单独的图并保存
for(i in 1:5) {
  cluster_data <- plot_data %>% filter(cluster_cont == i)
  
  p_single <- ggplot(cluster_data, aes(x = std_score, y = feature_clean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
             aes(fill = std_score > 0),
             width = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4575b4", "FALSE" = "#d73027"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("Segment Profile: Cluster", i), 
         x = "Standardized Score", 
         y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 单独保存每个图
  ggsave(paste0("cluster_", i, "_profile.png"), p_single, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  print(p_single)  # 在RStudio中显示
}

# 方法3：使用patchwork但避免plot_spacer（2x3布局，最后一个位置放图例或留空）
# 先创建5个图
plots <- list()
for(i in 1:5) {
  cluster_data <- plot_data %>% filter(cluster_cont == i)
  
  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(cluster_data, aes(x = std_score, y = feature_clean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
             aes(fill = std_score > 0),
             width = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4575b4", "FALSE" = "#d73027"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("Cluster", i), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}

# 创建图例说明的空白图
legend_plot <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
           label = "Blue: Above average\nRed: Below average\nDashed line: Group average", 
           size = 4, hjust = 0.5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

# 组合：2行，第一行3个图，第二行2个图+图例
combined_plot <- (plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) /
                 (plots[[4]] | plots[[5]] | legend_plot) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Key Feature Contribution per High-Risk Cluster",
    subtitle = "Standardized scores > 0 indicate the feature is above the group average.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40")
    )
  )

print(combined_plot)
ggsave("cluster_combined.png", combined_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
